title: Code of Conduct and Business Ethics
summary: Sets the standard of honest, lawful and respectful behaviour expected of everyone who works for or with Mindspace Artificial Intelligence Inc. and its subsidiaries.

title: Equal Opportunity and Anti-Discrimination
summary: Guarantees fair and equal treatment in hiring, pay, promotion, training, discipline and exit.

title: Religious Non-Discrimination and Freedom of Belief
summary: Protects every employee's right to hold, practise or not hold a religion or belief, free from discrimination, pressure or harassment.

title: Anti-Harassment and Anti-Bullying
summary: Ensures a workplace, online and offline, where no one is harassed, bullied or intimidated.

title: Staff Protection, Health, Safety and Safeguarding
owner: Head of Health, Safety and Security
summary: Protects the physical and mental health, safety and security of all staff, visitors and people affected by our work, including in robotics labs.

title: Whistleblowing (Speak Up)
summary: Gives everyone a safe, confidential and, if they wish, anonymous way to report wrongdoing, and protects them from retaliation.

title: Non-Retaliation
summary: Protects anyone who raises a concern, files a complaint or helps an investigation in good faith.

title: Data Privacy and Protection
summary: Explains how the company collects, uses, stores, shares and deletes personal data of employees, candidates and others, lawfully and transparently.

title: Information Security and Acceptable Use
summary: Protects company systems, devices and information, and sets rules for using email, internet, social media and AI tools.

title: Education, Training and Development
summary: Helps every employee grow their skills and career through training, education support and study leave.

title: Business Travel and Expenses
summary: Sets fair, safe and cost-effective rules for business travel and reimbursement of expenses.

title: Company Vehicle
summary: Sets eligibility, use, safety and cost rules for company cars, pool vehicles and car allowances.

title: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP)
summary: Lets employees share in the success of Mindspace Artificial Intelligence Inc. through options or restricted stock units over its shares.

title: Leave and Holidays
summary: Sets the types of leave available, how they accrue and how to apply, always meeting or beating each country's legal minimum.

title: Parental and Family
summary: Supports employees as they start or grow their families.

title: Flexible and Hybrid Work
summary: Lets office-based staff combine office and home working where the role allows, while keeping teams connected.

title: Compensation and Benefits
summary: Explains how pay and benefits are set, so they are fair, competitive and transparent.

title: Disciplinary and Grievance
summary: Ensures problems at work are handled fairly, consistently and lawfully.

title: Remote Work Policy
summary: Sets the rules, support and protections for staff who work fully remotely, mostly programmers, testers and developers (about 35% of the workforce).

title: Community Page, Chat and Copyright Guidelines
summary: Keeps the portal's chat and community page professional, safe, lawful and respectful of copyright.

title: Daily Activity Tracking and Employee Monitoring Notice
summary: Explains openly what the daily activity tracker and company systems record about employees, why, and how the data is protected.

title: Staff Advances, Loans and IOUs
summary: Sets fair and affordable rules for salary advances, staff loans and short-term IOUs.
